purpose.summary: Batch program that creates DPC (診療報酬点数 — medical fee claim) E and F files from receipt (レセプト) detail data stored in indexed files. It processes hospital admission/outpatient receipt records (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65, RECE68, RECE69, RECE900) and writes output to sequential DPC files (DPCE, DPCF) used for Japanese medical insurance billing.

notable_features: All comments are in Japanese (EUC or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1 garble)
COPY with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax (Micro Focus style)
Multiple indexed ISAM files with DYNAMIC access
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields (PIC 9 only)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — purely file-based
Large program: 6438 lines, 560 PIC clauses, 365 PERFORMs
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2007–2014
COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) for record layouts
verdict.notes: The file is clearly production COBOL for a Japanese hospital information system handling DPC (Diagnosis Procedure Combination) medical fee claim file creation. Comments are in Japanese encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded here as latin-1, producing garbled characters. The COPY REPLACING with // delimiters is characteristic of Micro Focus COBOL or certain Japanese vendor COBOL compilers. No COMP-3 is unusual for a numeric-heavy program but consistent with some Japanese COBOL environments. Source was truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is ~292KB / 6438 lines.
